scripts.local: mkdir -p logs && bun x concurrently --names "AZURITE,BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "green,blue,magenta" "bun run azurite" "bun run local:backend" "bun run local:frontend" | tee logs/local-run.log
scripts.e2e: bun x concurrently --names "backend,web" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta" "bun run e2e:backend" "bun run e2e:web"
scripts.e2e:serial: bun run e2e:backend && bun run e2e:web
